evals.name: service-kv-store-kvrocks-controller
evals.prompt: I just joined the team that maintains apache/kvrocks-controller and I've never read it. The repo is checked out at __REPOS__/kvrocks-controller. Help me learn this codebase from scratch: the key concepts and how they relate, the architecture, the main data flows, how it stores its state, the API surface, and whether the API is well designed. I can't answer questions right now, so write everything down for me to read later.
evals.expected_output: A markdown report with a glossary of project concepts cited to code/docs, a Mermaid concept-relationship map, a Mermaid architecture diagram, several Mermaid sequence diagrams for critical flows, a key-layout schema for the etcd/consul/zookeeper store, an API table, an orthogonality analysis with evidence, and a grill question tree with recommended answers.
assertions: Report file report.md exists and is substantial (>= 8k chars)
Glossary table with >= 10 concept rows
At least 80% of glossary rows carry a file:line or URL citation
Mermaid concept-relationship flowchart with labelled edges (>= 5 labels)
>= 30 distinct file:line citations that resolve to real files in the repo
No more than 10% of file:line citations point to non-existent files
External documentation URL referenced (README-linked doc site was consulted)
Orthogonality analysis section with a scoring table and the concept of orthogonality
Orthogonality findings cite code locations (>= 3 file:line in that section)
Grill / question section with >= 8 questions and recommended answers
States that the repo kind was classified (service / library) before analysis
Architecture flowchart with at least one subgraph (process boundary)
>= 3 sequenceDiagram blocks for critical data flows
Each data flow states what breaks if a step is skipped (>= 3 'break' statements)
API table with >= 15 endpoint rows
Key APIs described with request/response shape and error semantics
Schema presented as key-layout table (key prefixes) for the etcd/consul/zk store
Consistency mechanism of the store named (txn / cas / lease / election / watch)
Core concepts Namespace, Cluster, Shard, Node, Slot all defined in glossary
Explains controller leader election / failover as a flow

evals.name: library-hashicorp-raft

Teach me the codebase: what the core concepts mean and how they fit together, what the public interfaces are and which ones I have to implement myself, how its internals flow, and whether the interfaces are orthogonal. No one is around to answer questions, so leave the write-up for me.
